value.value: Siemens ET200SP via Scalance XB008 switch
IO-Link V1.1 via CM 4x IO-Link ST (4 ports)
Drills 4 holes into lower housing part; position-based via CPS technology (X+Z pneumatic axes, dual drill unit)
Z-axis upper end position sensor (drill retracted)
Z-axis lower end position sensor (drill advanced)
Drill unit 1 (double drill assembly, left pair)
Drill unit 2 (double drill assembly, right pair)
Inrush current limiter for drill MA1
Inrush current limiter for drill MA2
Compact valve terminal — controls X and Z axis pneumatics + Z-axis lock
X-axis pneumatic linear drive — positions drill over workpiece
Z-axis mini slide — lowers/raises drill units
Exhaust flow control valves (×4) — speed regulation for X and Z axes
BG1 — X-axis left endstop (SMT-10M, art.551373); PNP NO
BG2 — X-axis right endstop (SMT-10M, art.551373); PNP NO
BG3 — Front cover orientation sensor (SOEG-L-Q30, art.8127556); PNP NO
BG4 — Front cover workpiece present (SOEG-L-Q30, art.8127556); PNP NO
BG5 — Z-axis upper endstop / drill retracted (SMT-10M, art.551373); PNP NO
BG6 — Z-axis lower endstop / drill advanced (SMT-10M, art.551373); PNP NO
BG8 — Back cover workpiece present (SOEG-L-Q30, art.8127556); PNP NO
MB1 — CPVSC1 valve: X-axis move to left (home)
MB2 — CPVSC1 valve: X-axis move to right (drill position)
MB5 — CPVSC1 valve: Z-axis retract drill (up)
MB6 — CPVSC1 valve: Z-axis advance drill (down)
MB7 — CPVSC1 valve: Z-axis lock open
